summary: Thermodynamics is that branch of physics in which we study: (A) No heat transfers to the environment. (B) Neither…
alt: Ex MCQ 12: Thermodynamics is that branch of physics in which we study: (A) No heat transfers to the environment. (B) Neither heat nor any mass are transferred to the environment. (C) No dissipated energy and heat transferred to the environment. (D) No mass transfers to the environment.

steps.title: Read the question
steps.text: Which option completes the sentence? (All four options actually describe a kind of isolated system.)

steps.title: What the options describe
steps.text: Only option (B) says **neither heat nor mass** crosses the boundary: that is a fully **isolated system**.

steps.title: Answer: (B)
steps.text: Key (B). Note: in general thermodynamics studies how heat changes into other forms of energy; the stem is worded loosely, so pick the option that describes an isolated system.

formulas.title: Isolated system
formulas.text: No heat or mass crosses the boundary.
